retrieval_method: Ordinary browser download from the exact URL observed in the public LAPLACE Persona catalog. The original archive hash was verified before safe extraction.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
license.declared_by: LAPLACE Persona model documentation; embedded meta licenseName=CC_BY_NC_SA, commercialUssageName=Disallow.
license.scope: Noncommercial evaluation sample. Keep author attribution; adaptations are subject to the stated ShareAlike license. No commercial grant is claimed.

modifications: Original VRM geometry, texture, metadata, and animation bytes remain unchanged. Current transport is deterministic lossless gzip (level 9, mtime 0, no filename header), which decompresses byte-for-byte to the source archive member. The earlier two-part raw transport trial is retained in history. Runtime-only adaptation corrects VRM0 arm-pose and gaze axes and binds 13 empty expression slots only to exact existing Fcl_* morph names; existing bindings and the VRM1 control pose are preserved. These in-memory changes are not saved into the model or gzip transport.

hosting.format: Deterministic lossless gzip; not image compression or model conversion.
hosting.default_selection_context: Default selected following the user reference-model correction. The previous Milky Green reconstruction remains separately selectable as requested; local VRM import remains available.

transport_history.status: Superseded by lossless gzip; former files removed from dist.

hosting.decompression: Native DecompressionStream preferred; fixed official fflate 0.8.2 streaming Gunzip compatibility fallback, served locally.

reference_video.author: LAPLACE Live! × 彩茫
reference_video.scope: Name and credit match public page description and Persona catalog. The first video did not provide a playable frame during the observed redirect, so pixel/appearance identity is not asserted.

identity_scope: A source-linked Wenjing sample from the credited author catalog. Its embedded name and author match the first reference video description; this does not assert that its file bytes or rendered appearance are identical to the particular video model, and does not identify the separate Live2D references as this VRM.
validation_limit: Archive and transport integrity, source metadata, CPU geometry/expression compatibility, production gzip reading through native and fflate paths, and real cloud-browser texture decoding are verified within their stated scopes. No GPU rendering, physical camera, Mac Safari, or video-frame appearance acceptance is claimed.

runtime_adapter.scope: In-memory renderer compatibility for VRM0 axis conventions and empty expression slots. Source VRM bytes remain unchanged through the lossless gzip transport.
runtime_adapter.expression_binding_rule: Only empty expressions with exact known Fcl_* morph target names in the loaded model are repaired; existing expression bindings are preserved.

cpu_validation.implementation: Real vendored GLTF/VRM parsers, actual renderer pose/look/expression/scale helpers, CPU skin and morph vertices.
cpu_validation.texture_decoding: Explicit 1x1 mock; no texture/shader appearance validation.
cpu_validation.vrm1_control: Existing bindings and pose preserved; no expression repairs required.
cpu_validation.limits: No GPU, shader/texture pixels, actual browser view, performance or video-frame appearance identity verified. Empty VRM0 expression repair is limited to exact known Fcl_* names.

catalog_thumbnail_observation.observation_method: Ordinary public browser observation of the external catalog thumbnail.
catalog_thumbnail_observation.scope: Consistent with observed Live2D design features. This is not a GPU-rendered model or pixel-level video comparison. The embedded image named Thumbnail is a facial texture image.

browser_decode_validation.transport: Both parts returned HTTP 200 with exact sizes; concatenated whole-model SHA-256 verified.
browser_decode_validation.loader: Actual vendored GLTFLoader and VRMLoaderPlugin with native ImageBitmapLoader.
browser_decode_validation.limits: No WebGLRenderer or GPU rendering was used; no physical camera, Mac Safari, performance acceptance, or video-frame identity is implied.
browser_decode_validation.transport_status: Historical validation of the earlier raw-parts transport; model decoding evidence is retained. This is not a claim that the subsequent gzip reader was exercised in that run.

gzip_packaging_validation.scope: Lossless packaging integrity; separate from GPU, camera, and physical-device acceptance.

gzip_browser_decode_validation.method: Ordinary browser activation of the native and fflate test buttons, both using the production model-source.mjs readModel implementation followed by actual vendored GLTFLoader/VRMLoaderPlugin and native ImageBitmapLoader.
gzip_browser_decode_validation.limits: No WebGL renderer or GPU rendering was used. These checks do not establish Mac Safari, physical camera operation, physical-device appearance, video-frame identity, or a performance benchmark.
